sources.finding: Official GeoTIFF products are Sentinel-1 PSI-derived and therefore not independent of Sentinel-1. The closest identified Mexico City product is the 2019 velocity/hundimiento raster, 30 m, ITRF2008 epoch 2010.0, catalog UPC 889463849650.
sources.geometry: combined ascending and descending Sentinel-1 to estimate vertical displacement

sources.finding: Coverage 98.8–99.25 W and 19.15–19.65 N; 2019; GeoTIFF; 30 m; values described as millimetres/year.
sources.independence: Sentinel-1-derived; useful only as historical/spatial-pattern comparison

sources.finding: Five-year geodetic-deformation monitoring using GNSS and SAR, focused on tectonic/seismic deformation. No downloadable 2024 Mexico City subsidence raster or station time-series product was identified.
sources.independence: mixed GNSS/SAR program; product-specific provenance required

sources.finding: RINEX 2.11/3.04; hourly 15-second files and daily 30-second RINEX 2.11. ICMX is explicitly unavailable until further notice because interference produces low-quality data; TOL2 is the nearest usable RGNA station outside the AOI.

sources.resource: All CORS sites and data products
sources.finding: MMX1 Mexico City WAAS is continuous from GPS day 2008:116, nominal 1-second recent sampling decimated to 30 seconds after 30 days; 2024 raw RINEX is available. TOL2 is listed at 15-second recent sampling.

sources.resource: Plug and Play GPS final solutions
sources.finding: Daily IGS20 and North-America-frame processed ENU time series are available in tenv3 ASCII. NGL DataHoldings was filtered over an AOI plus regional buffer; actual 2024 counts were checked for ICMX, MMX1, MXTO, MXTX, and TOL2.
sources.independence: independent GNSS observations processed by NGL

sources.finding: USGS identifies Mexican GNSS data providers but no USGS-operated continuous station or 2024 Mexico City displacement product was found for this AOI.
sources.independence: no directly usable local product identified

availability_summary.reason: Only two stations fall inside the 26-by-28 km AOI; MMX1 is incomplete in 2024, and the out-of-AOI stations do not sample the interior east-west field densely enough.
